=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3978-4070 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The compare-API-error clear-pin branches in finalize_integration_merge_if_needed update STATE_FILE but skip post_state_comment, leaving tracking-issue comments stale.
  WHY: The state transitions to pending without the corresponding comment update, so operators see a merged pin that has already been cleared; both reviewers noted the missing comment on the compare-error path.
- tests/test_orchestrate_integration_ahead_by_gate.py:170-189 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The test force-patches the generated gh stub with a fragile string replacement that depends on the exact stub text.
  WHY: Any future stub formatting change can prevent the 404 ref lookup from being injected, making the test exercise the compare path and fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2178-2210 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: _integration_branch_ahead_of_default probes branch existence with the raw branch name but percent-encodes only the compare call.
  WHY: Reserved characters in branch names can make the existence check and compare endpoint refer to different refs, yielding incorrect ahead_by handling or fail-closed errors.
- tests/test_orchestrate_integration_ahead_by_gate.py:test_finalize_clears_pin_when_integration_ahead_of_default and test_finalize_clears_pin_fail_closed_on_compare_api_error | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The finalize-pin-clearing tests assert on a non-zero exit from an implementation detail rather than the pin-clearing contract itself.
  WHY: A future refactor that keeps the contract but changes internal control flow could make the tests fail for unrelated reasons.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2578-2598 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Adding integration_ahead_by and integration_contained_in_default changes the JSON output shape for older consumers.
  WHY: Callers that validate an exact schema or are not prepared to ignore sibling keys can break even though project_complete remains compatible.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1530-1530 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The compare-endpoint mock regex `[^.]+` does not match dotted branch names.
  WHY: Valid Git branches can contain dots, so the mock may not trigger for some refs and can cause unexpected test failures or fall through to real API calls.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_integration_ahead_by_gate.py: lines 170-189 (the patched gh stub that overrides the git/ref/heads endpoint) + test_helper_returns_zero_when_branch_was_deleted | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test manually patches the generated Python gh stub after _make_gh_stub has already written it, using a fragile string replace on a multi-line f-string that contains the exact text being replaced.
  WHY: Any future change to the stub generator can silently stop forcing the 404 ref lookup, so the test hits the compare API and fails its assertion.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: _integration_branch_ahead_of_default (new helper, lines ~2178-2210 in the PR diff) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: integration_branch_exists is called before percent-encoding the branch name for the compare URL, so the existence probe and compare call can become inconsistent.
  WHY: A branch name with reserved characters can make the probe and compare endpoint refer to different refs, leading to incorrect ahead_by handling or API errors.
- tests/test_orchestrate_integration_ahead_by_gate.py: test_finalize_clears_pin_when_integration_ahead_of_default and test_finalize_clears_pin_fail_closed_on_compare_api_error | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The tests rely on finalize_integration_merge_if_needed taking a non-zero exit on the recreate path instead of checking the pin-clearing contract directly.
  WHY: A future refactor that preserves behavior but changes internal control flow could break the tests for unrelated reasons.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py: cmd_check_wave_status (new --integration-ahead-by argument, default="0", lines 2578-2598 in PR diff) + callers in orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9378-9416 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new --integration-ahead-by path adds extra JSON fields that older callers may not expect.
  WHY: Consumers that validate an exact JSON shape or don't ignore sibling keys can break even though project_complete remains compatible.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: finalize_integration_merge_if_needed (new re-check block ~3978-4008 and the recorded-PR block ~4040-4070) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the re-check clears the "merged" pin, the function falls through without guaranteeing that post_state_comment() has been called after the jq mutation.
  WHY: The state file changes on disk but the tracking comment stays stale in the same poll tick.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
